function.arguments:
{"script":"# 4. matrix_sanitized.txt
# Using sed to normalize line endings and remove nulls
sudo cat /root/matrix.txt | tr -d '\000' | sed 's/\r$//' > matrix_sanitized.txt

# 5. line_preview.txt
head -n 100 matrix_sanitized.txt > line_preview.txt
tail -n 100 matrix_sanitized.txt >> line_preview.txt

# 6. empty_line_index.txt
grep -n "^$" matrix_sanitized.txt | cut -d: -f1 > empty_line_index.txt

# 7. nonprinting_report.txt
# Lines with non-printable characters (outside ASCII 32-126, \t, \n, \r)
grep -n "[^[:print:][:space:]]" matrix_sanitized.txt > nonprinting_report.txt

# 8. Checksum compare
sha256sum matrix_sanitized.txt | awk '{print $1}' > matrix_checksum_sanitized.txt
INIT_SUM=$(cat matrix_checksum_initial.txt)
SANI_SUM=$(cat matrix_checksum_sanitized.txt)
if [ "$INIT_SUM" = "$SANI_SUM" ]; then
    echo "Checksums match." > checksum_verify.txt
else
    echo "Checksums differ." > checksum_verify.txt
    echo "The sanitized file differs from the original copy." > modification_note.txt
fi

# 9. workspace_summary.txt
echo "File Sizes:" > workspace_summary.txt
